items.headline: Phil Mickelson’s LIV Payout
items.text: Phil Mickelson earned a massive payout from LIV Golf in 2026 despite playing in just one tournament, revealed in LIV Golf's bankruptcy filings.

items.headline: Katsuragawa’s DP World Tour Win
items.text: Yuto Katsuragawa claimed his second DP World Tour title at the Genesis Championship in South Korea, finishing 13-under 271 and moving to 28th in the Race to Dubai.
